ddl.value:
("target_date_from" IS NOT NULL AND "target_date" IS NULL
      AND ("target_date_to" IS NULL OR "target_date_to" >= "target_date_from"))
    OR ("target_date_from" IS NULL AND "target_date_to" IS NULL
      AND "target_date" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("target_date") <> '')
ddl.name: corporate_inquiry_target_dates_consistent

ddl.value:
("status" IN ('NEW', 'SPAM') AND "contacted_at" IS NULL AND "proposal_sent_at" IS NULL
      AND "closed_at" IS NULL AND "lost_reason" IS NULL)
    OR ("status" = 'CONTACTED' AND "contacted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "proposal_sent_at" IS NULL
      AND "closed_at" IS NULL AND "lost_reason" IS NULL)
    OR ("status" = 'PROPOSAL_SENT' AND "contacted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "proposal_sent_at" IS NOT NULL
      AND "estimated_value_centavos" IS NOT NULL AND "closed_at" IS NULL AND "lost_reason" IS NULL)
    OR ("status" = 'WON' AND "contacted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "proposal_sent_at" IS NOT NULL
      AND "estimated_value_centavos" IS NOT NULL AND "closed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "lost_reason" IS NULL)
    OR ("status" = 'LOST' AND "closed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "lost_reason" IS NOT NULL
      AND btrim("lost_reason") <> ''
      AND ("proposal_sent_at" IS NULL OR ("contacted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "estimated_value_centavos" IS NOT NULL)))
ddl.name: corporate_inquiry_lifecycle_consistent

ddl.value:
("registration_id" IS NOT NULL AND "corporate_inquiry_id" IS NULL
      AND "kind"::text IN ('payment_instructions', 'payment_acknowledgment'))
    OR ("corporate_inquiry_id" IS NOT NULL AND "registration_id" IS NULL
      AND "kind"::text IN ('corporate_acknowledgment', 'corporate_notification', 'corporate_overdue'))
ddl.name: crm_email_job_owner_kind

ddl.value:
("attempt_count" = 0 AND "first_attempt_at" IS NULL AND "last_attempt_at" IS NULL)
    OR ("attempt_count" > 0 AND "first_attempt_at" IS NOT NULL
      AND "last_attempt_at" IS NOT NULL AND "last_attempt_at" >= "first_attempt_at")
ddl.name: crm_email_job_attempts_consistent

ddl.value:
("state" = 'sending' AND "attempt_count" > 0 AND "lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)
    OR ("state" <> 'sending' AND "lease_expires_at" IS NULL)
ddl.name: crm_email_job_lease_consistent

ddl.value:
("state" = 'sent' AND "attempt_count" > 0 AND "sent_at" IS NOT NULL
      AND "provider_id" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("provider_id") <> '')
    OR ("state" <> 'sent' AND "sent_at" IS NULL AND "provider_id" IS NULL)
ddl.name: crm_email_job_sent_consistent

ddl.value: ("corporate_inquiry_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("registration_id" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: crm_submission_key_one_owner

ddl.value:
(NOT "is_paid" AND "payment_method" IS NULL AND "paid_amount_centavos" IS NULL
      AND "payer_name" IS NULL AND "provider_transaction_reference" IS NULL
      AND "verified_at" IS NULL AND "verified_by" IS NULL)
    OR ("payment_method" IS NOT NULL AND "paid_amount_centavos" IS NOT NULL
      AND "payer_name" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("payer_name") <> ''
      AND "provider_transaction_reference" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("provider_transaction_reference") <> ''
      AND "verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "verified_by" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: registration_verification_consistent

ddl.value:
("cancelled_at" IS NULL AND "cancelled_by" IS NULL AND "cancellation_reason" IS NULL)
    OR ("cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "cancelled_by" IS NOT NULL AND NOT "is_paid"
      AND "cancellation_reason" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("cancellation_reason") <> '')
ddl.name: registration_cancellation_consistent
